section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 1. Workers AI Monetization & Edge GPU Inference Scale
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Cloudflare has placed GPUs across hundreds of cities in its global edge network, enabling sub-millisecond AI inference without centralized hyperscaler egress fees. Institutional investors are seeking evidence that developer uptake of Workers AI and Vectorize is driving material incremental ARR rather than cannibalizing legacy CDN usage.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 2. Zero Trust & SASE Consolidation vs Palo Alto Networks & Zscaler
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: As Fortune 500 CISOs consolidate security point solutions, Cloudflare One is aggressively competing against Zscaler and Palo Alto Networks. Analysts want color on contract win rates for enterprise-wide Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and single-vendor secure connectivity replacements.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 3. High Multiple Valuation Durability & FCF Conversion (38.7x P/S)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Trading at 38.66x TTM sales and 161.2x forward P/E, Cloudflare trades at one of the highest multiples in enterprise software. While Operating Cash Flow reached $117.56M in Q2, stock-based compensation of $159.87M resulted in True FCF of -$103.49M. Bulls argue network architecture moat justifies premium; bears warn of multiple compression on any growth deceleration.
